notes: Shopify store, reached by direct HTTP fetch (no proxy needed, consistent with prior Furniture pass). Discovery: main nav mega-menus per room (Living/Dining/Bedroom/Office/Outdoor/Lighting/Decor) each expose a 'Bestsellers' tier-2 link; the homepage also features a sitewide 'Bestsellers' product carousel with a 'View All' link to /collections/bestsellers, plus a promo-bar link to the same URL. Confirmed sitemap_collections_1.xml for additional bestseller-themed handles not in main nav: in-stock-bestsellers, bestselling-sofa-collections, bestselling-storage-and-organization. Site search (/search?q=...&type=collection) returned identical static mega-menu boilerplate for every query tried (outlet/clearance/bestsellers/new arrivals/best sellers) - not real search results, so treated as non-discriminating per brief and not relied upon; navigation+sitemap were the real discovery path. All qty values below verified via the literal on-page text 'Showing 1 to N of N items' (theme facets__product-count block), which for a spot-check page (table-lamps) exactly matched an independent unique-product-id count and the prior pass's cross-check methodology. General /collections/bestsellers (37) is NOT the union of the 7 room-specific lists (which sum to 108) - it is a smaller, separately-curated sitewide top-sellers list; both scopes are genuine, distinct, site-exposed listings, so both are kept (overlap is expected per brief, not an error). bestselling-sofa-collections and bestselling-storage-and-organization: real product-card grids render in the SSR HTML (35 and 38 unique data-product-id values respectively, no pagination controls), but neither page renders a 'Showing X of Y' total and the legacy /products.json endpoint for both returns an empty array (200 OK, likely an app/search-and-discovery-managed collection not reflected in the legacy Storefront API) - could not confirm the site's own authoritative total, so qty is null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than guessing from the DOM count. Both are also not linked from main navigation (sitemap-only). No local-language variant needed (US site, English only).
